purpose: Runtime scene-position overrides distilled from UnleashedRecomp's PPC->C++ source. The retail .yncp asset stores authoring-time cast positions; the live runtime walks specific scenes each frame and overrides them via Chao::CSD::CCastNode setPosition (sub_830BB3D0). Without these overrides, our renderer places info_bg_1 / info_img_* at their authoring positions which differs from the runtime layout.

ppc_address_setPosition_layout.comment: stores f30 at +44, f31 at +48 of the CCastNode (Chao::CSD)

scene_overrides.guessed_basis: first repositioned scene; matches the Phase 291 horizontal-vs-vertical layout gap on the green grid panel
second repositioned scene; same x formula with offsetX=0
third repositioned scene; same overrides as 0x34

linked_list_overrides.comment: variable-length list of additional scenes (ring count, medal level, etc.); same x shift, y untouched
